requirements.text: A user-friendly online booking interface for customers to select services and barbers.
The ability for customers to cancel or change appointments online.
Automated reminders sent via text and email, 24 hours and an hour before appointments.
Barbers to manage their own schedules and set their availability.
Barbers should have the option to block off time for breaks or personal appointments.
Real-time updates to barber schedules without needing approval.
Daily and weekly booking summaries showing total appointments, cancellations, no-shows, peak times, and repeat no-show tracking.
The booking system must be mobile-friendly for customers booking from their phones.
The solution must be budget-friendly for the barbershop.
